name: TwinFlow Field Lead Intake
description: On-site B2B prospect qualification, equipment/workspace audit, and instant CRM lead capture.
persona: B2B field sales engineer and CRM intake specialist

items.label: Account Signage & Location Verification
items.promptHint: Snap storefront or reception signage and speak the primary contact name and role.

items.label: Existing Equipment / Tech Stack Audit
items.promptHint: Capture current hardware, POS, or machinery model plate to identify replacement fit.

items.label: Workflow Bottleneck & Monthly Volume
items.promptHint: Speak the prospect's top pain point, team size, and monthly transaction/unit volume.

items.label: Budget Authority & Target Go-Live
items.promptHint: Record decision maker status, estimated budget range, and target deployment month.

items.label: Next Step & Follow-Up Commitment
items.promptHint: Snap business card or quote sheet and speak the agreed follow-up date and deliverable.
